methods.label: Pair consecutive terms
methods.explanation:
Each positive odd-numbered term and the following negative even-numbered term have sum \(-1\):
\[
1-2=-1,\qquad 3-4=-1,\qquad\ldots.
\]
There are eight such pairs in \(S_{17}\), followed by \(+17\), so \(S_{17}=-8+17=9\). Similarly, \(S_{33}\) has sixteen pairs followed by \(+33\), giving \(S_{33}=-16+33=17\). All fifty terms of \(S_{50}\) form twenty-five pairs, so \(S_{50}=-25\).

Therefore,
\[
S_{17}+S_{33}+S_{50}=9+17-25=1.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{1}\), choice B.
